findings.title: Job 'close_cycle' started and never finished

findings.summary: 9 threads waited 75 times (8/s) for mutex 0x0000001a5c80cac8; someone was waiting 0% of the time; p99 wait 3.13 ms.
findings.qnx_note: Every MUTEX-state interval is real contention: uncontended QNX mutexes never enter the kernel. Shrink the critical section (copy outside the lock), split the lock per resource, or hand buffers between threads with message passing.

findings.title: Unusual behaviour in nng_repro[16]
findings.summary: nng_repro[16] (prio 10) behaved unlike healthy QNX programs in 247 of its 247 time windows; the most unusual stretch lasted 4940 ms. It stands out in: time waiting on a condition variable (higher than healthy), longest single block (higher than healthy), CPU migrations (higher than healthy). The closest pattern TraceLens has seen is priority inversion while waiting on a condition variable, but only loosely (distance 10.06 against 0.847 typical for it): treat this as behaviour of its own.
findings.qnx_note: Learned from healthy QNX 8.0 traces: this thread behaved unlike any healthy run in the features listed. It is not a proven bug and gets no automatic fix: look at the timeline around it. Any resemblance to a known pattern is measured against labelled example windows, never a rule that fired.
